shared_elements: marks made on a rock surface
human-related figural or sign content (figure in A; figural/hieroglyphic signs in B)
repeated small marks in horizontal rows (crew strokes on boat in A; rows of signs in B)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic anthropomorphic/figural marks and rows of small repeated elements arranged horizontally, but that is about as generic as rock-surface imagery gets. A depicts a large striding figure raising a hafted implement above a boat with a row of crew strokes and an animal, whereas B presents dense registers of small, uniform inscribed signs with no single dominant scene or narrative actor.
